name: Colour
description: #ff6644, #fff on #333, pick: a colour's forms and contrast, a screen colour picker, palette exports

help.title: Colours
help.about: A hex, rgb(), hsl() or oklch() colour shows a swatch, its forms and its contrast on white and black. "formats" picks the forms (hex, rgb, hsl, oklch, hsv, hwb, lab, lch, oklab, cmyk, vec4, decimal, 0x); "contrast": false leaves out the contrast

help.title: Contrast
help.about: Two colours on each other: their WCAG contrast ratio, and whether text and large text pass

help.title: Colour picker
help.about: Click any pixel on screen. Enter does "afterPick" (copy+show), Shift+Enter "afterPickAlt" (copy): copy it in "copyFormat", open the bar on it, or both. pick and a space lists what you picked and copies it as CSS, SCSS, JSON, Tailwind or a GIMP palette ("exports")
